Method of Attack: Exploiting Microsoft Exchange server vulnerabilities CVE-2022-41080 and CVE-2022-41082 to gain remote privilege escalation and remote code execution
Dropping remote access tools such as Plink, AnyDesk, and ConnectWise for remote administration
Stealing data before deploying ransomware payloads and threatening to leak data if ransom is not paid
Attack Vector: OWASSRF exploit targeting Microsoft Exchange servers
